pages.text: Watch for pack leaders, Blood Moons, and treasure bags. The world escalates through three difficulty stages as you advance. Each stage adds mechanics like these and is deadlier, but also more rewarding.$(br2)You cannot opt out. The world $(italic)will$() become harder as you progress.

pages.title: Difficulty Stages
pages.text: $(bold)Normal (T1-T2)$(): from world start. Standard mob behavior: mobs have base HP scaling and spawn in basic patterns.$(br2)$(bold)Expert (T3)$(): starts when you enter the Nether. Mobs gain new abilities and spawn in larger groups, and elite encounters come more often.$(br2)$(bold)Master (T4)$(): starts when you kill the Ender Dragon. The world is fully hostile. Every encounter is a real fight.

pages.title: Mob Groups
pages.text: Mobs can spawn in $(thing)leader/follower packs$(): a leader mob with a small squad of followers that coordinate their attacks. Leaders look different from their followers and are much stronger.$(br2)Because of packs, you cannot safely ignore trash mobs: something dangerous is backing them. Crowd control and AoE become essential as difficulty scales.

pages.title: Blood Moon & Raids
pages.text: A $(bold)Blood Moon$() can start at random at nightfall. While it lasts, mobs spawn far more often and are more aggressive. You can wait it out indoors, or fight through it for a big payout.$(br2)$(bold)Undead Army$() raids can target your base, sending waves of undead at your position, each stronger than the last. Defend it and the rewards are strong; fail and you have a lot of cleanup.

pages.title: Treasure Bags
pages.text: Boss kills award $(thing)treasure bags$(): loot containers you right-click, with drops rolled per player. Everyone who takes part in a boss kill gets their own bag, so group play is never punished.$(br2)What a bag holds scales with the difficulty stage and the boss tier. Bags are one of the best sources of progression materials and rare items.

pages.title: Bleeding Effect
pages.text: Mobs can inflict the $(thing)Bleeding$() effect on you: damage over time that ignores armor, and a real threat in long fights.$(br2)$(bold)Cures:$() $(thing)Bandages$() (crafted, cure it instantly), a $(thing)Milk Bucket$() (clears all effects), or a $(thing)Golden Apple$() (clears bleeding and gives regen).$(br2)$(bold)Always carry bandages.$() Most deaths happen while bleeding in a mob pack with no cure on hand.
